query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
            FROM deals d
            JOIN customers c ON c.id = d.customer_id
            WHERE d.org_id = $1
              AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR d.customer_id = $2)
              AND ($3::text IS NULL OR d.stage = $3)
              AND ($4::text IS NULL OR d.title ILIKE $4 OR c.name ILIKE $4)
